difference_calls.reading: Both directions are dominated by set-size and vocabulary artifacts (advisor issue 4). The one asymmetry that survives: the uncited side carries neuron/subspace-level mechanism vocabulary (SWEA, subspace, neurons, token dimension) that the cited side lacks, while the cited side carries the program's own lifecycle vocabulary (null space, anchor, codebook, retrieval). Treated as a lead only.

A2: activation-matched soft prompts supervised by causal localization
attention-mass over the subject as the mask for which neurons to write (interference measurable before the write)
retrieval-gated attention bias instead of a prefix
B2: edit target constructed inside the low-curvature / critical-feature subspace (SUIT x CrispEdit x forward replay)
knowledge-general vs knowledge-specific neurons as a basis: write only in the specific span
per-fact locality budget conditioned on pre-edit familiarity (Knowledge Spectrum)
breadth-first mini-batch fine-tuning as a live baseline (Fine-tuning Done Right)
neighbor-assisted editing as a continuous locality signal / stopping rule
